title: Skipped work to party with Grant Gustin and @Water For Elephants Musi...
transcript: Come with me to the water for elephants cast album listing party. We are so excited and privileged to host you all here for the official listening party of the water for elephants original Broadway Cast Recording. It's unbelievable and surreal, and we're so grateful to all of you for being a part of this journey and allowing our music to be a part of this show is. It's one of the greatest honors of our lives. 우
